# opentelgrpc

[![Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/metrics/opentel/opentelgrpc.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/metrics/opentel/opentelgrpc)

Package opentelgrpc adds OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics to gRPC servers and
clients.

`Instrumenter` wraps the stats handlers of
go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/otelgrpc:
  - `Instrumenter.ServerOptions` returns a grpc.StatsHandler option with the
    otelgrpc server handler, and `Instrumenter.DialOptions` a
    grpc.WithStatsHandler option with the otelgrpc client handler. They
    satisfy the grpcutil.ServerInstrumenter and grpcutil.ClientInstrumenter
    interfaces, so an Instrumenter is passed to grpcserver.WithInstrumenter
    and grpcclient.WithInstrumenter.
  - The handlers create a span for every RPC, propagate the trace context
    through the request metadata, and record the rpc.server.* and
    rpc.client.* metrics defined by the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

## Providers

The global tracer, meter, and propagator providers are used by default:
`github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/metrics/opentel.New` installs them, so no
further wiring is needed. `WithTracerProvider`, `WithMeterProvider`, and
`WithPropagators` set explicit ones.

## Filtering

By default the RPCs of the grpc.health.v1.Health service and of the
grpc.reflection.* services are not instrumented, so health probes and
reflection clients do not flood the trace backend. Filtered RPCs produce
neither spans nor metrics. `WithFilter` adds more filters, and
`WithoutDefaultFilter` removes the default one.

## When To Use

  - A service exports OpenTelemetry traces and metrics and serves or calls
    gRPC APIs.
  - Trace context must propagate across gRPC calls as it does across HTTP
    calls.

## Example

```go
ctx := context.Background()
logger := slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler)

// Without WithTracerProvider, WithMeterProvider, and WithPropagators the
// global providers installed by metrics/opentel.New are used.
spans := tracetest.NewSpanRecorder()

in, err := opentelgrpc.New(
	opentelgrpc.WithTracerProvider(sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithSpanProcessor(spans))),
)
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

srv, err := grpcserver.New(
	ctx,
	exampleBinder{},
	grpcserver.WithServerAddr("127.0.0.1:0"),
	grpcserver.WithLogger(logger),
	grpcserver.WithHealthService(nil),
	grpcserver.WithInstrumenter(in),
)
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

srv.StartServer()

conn, err := grpcclient.New(
	srv.Addr().String(),
	grpcclient.WithInsecure(),
	grpcclient.WithLogger(logger),
	grpcclient.WithInstrumenter(in),
)
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

defer func() { _ = conn.Close() }()

_, err = testgrpc.NewTestServiceClient(conn).UnaryCall(ctx, &testgrpc.SimpleRequest{})
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

// Health checks are not traced by default.
_, err = healthpb.NewHealthClient(conn).Check(ctx, &healthpb.HealthCheckRequest{})
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

// A server span ends after the response is sent. Shutdown waits for the
// running RPCs, so every span has ended once it returns.
err = srv.Shutdown(ctx)
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
	return
}

var names []string
for _, s := range spans.Ended() {
	names = append(names, s.SpanKind().String()+" "+s.Name())
}

slices.Sort(names)

for _, n := range names {
	fmt.Println(n)
}

// Output:
// client grpc.testing.TestService/UnaryCall
// server grpc.testing.TestService/UnaryCall
```

Full source is in [example_opentelgrpc_test.go](example_opentelgrpc_test.go).
More runnable examples are on [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/metrics/opentel/opentelgrpc#pkg-examples).

## Dependencies

- `github.com/cespare/xxhash/v2`
- `github.com/go-logr/logr`
- `github.com/go-logr/stdr`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/auto/sdk`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/otelgrpc`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/log`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric`
- `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace`
- `golang.org/x/net`
- `golang.org/x/sys`
- `golang.org/x/text`
- `google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/rpc`
- `google.golang.org/grpc`
- `google.golang.org/protobuf`
